product_one_liner.value: PolyAI provides an enterprise conversational AI platform for building, running and improving voice and chat agents that handle complex customer-service interactions.

employee_band.notes: The company about page reports 250 employees.

hq_location.notes: Vendor-verified directory and corporate-office profile identify London; LinkedIn separately labels San Francisco as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by machine-learning engineer Tomasz Cichy explain ASR model fine-tuning, training data and accuracy evaluation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists Staff Product Manager (Runtime Team), Senior Marketing Manager, EMEA, and Senior Account Manager; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: PolyAI proprietary Raven models and Dialog-RSN-1; configurable OpenAI models and Anthropic Claude/Amazon Nova models through Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: Public documentation lists model options; this does not imply every deployment uses every provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Explicitly attained SOC 2 Type II compliance and ISO 27001 certification. The compliance page also states GDPR compliance, describes HIPAA-oriented design, and commits to PCI-DSS compliance; those statements are not additional completed certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The $86 million Series D was announced on 2025-12-15, within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The three listed openings include Senior Account Manager, not an SDR, BDR or Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Wren on 2026-09-09, an agent that analyzes conversations and tests improvements to dialog agents.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sunil Shah was appointed Chief Financial Officer on 2026-10-08.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Account Manager posting explicitly describes pipeline work in Gong. The Business Development Manager posting names the other systems as GTM experience requirements, including Outreach or Salesloft as alternatives; this signals the stack but does not prove both alternatives are deployed.
